picks.why: Eaton grows revenue 28% with an 18% operating margin at 20.9x forward earnings, 28% off its high, in a segment the worldview rates overweight. Grid equipment is the physical bottleneck for data centres, and order strength at peers such as Powell supports it.
picks.risk: Data-centre permit restrictions slow orders, or the FCF yield of 2% proves too thin if the multiple compresses further.

picks.why: KLA earns a 45% operating margin on 29% revenue growth at 19.5x forward earnings, 55% off its high, and the watchlist covers the segment only through ASML. It is the highest-quality cash generator among the shortlisted equipment names.
picks.risk: A capex pause by chipmakers after the sell-off would cut orders, and the stock is still 24% below its 200-day average.
